confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not from live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies more by season, event calendar, and property type. Local prices are reasoned in EUR and converted to USD at an assumed rate of about 1.15 to 1.17 USD per EUR, so currency movement adds some error. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer and restaurant price relationship. The RBA rate was taken from search results that reference the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page; that page was not opened directly during this run.
comparable_city_reasoning: Eurozone capital priced below Vienna, with restaurant and hotel levels broadly similar to mid-tier Central European capitals such as Budapest and Prague, and some uplift in summer from Vienna-area and other short-break tourism.
